r=pathlib.Path('/mnt/d/codex/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103');p=r/'research/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103/POST_S3_PROPOSER_20261104/N0B';sha='e0715393231a5202eb99d9bd690a95ad430d1b8b'
def module(name):
 f=p/(name+'.py');raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','--git-dir='+str(r/'.git'),'show',sha+':'+f.relative_to(r).as_posix()]);m=types.ModuleType(name);m.__file__=str(f);exec(compile(raw,str(f),'exec'),m.__dict__);return m
e=module('endpoints_n0b');s=module('summary_n0b');rt=module('rates');tests=0
def check(ok):
 global tests
 if not ok:raise AssertionError(tests)
 tests+=1
n=101;t=np.arange(n)*.2
truth=np.zeros((n,3));P=np.tile(np.diag([.01,.04,.0004,.0001]),(n,1,1));x=np.zeros((n,4));x[:,0]=.02;x[:,1]=.03;x[:,2]=np.radians(.5);x[:,3]=.001
a=e.measure(t,x,P,truth,0.,True)
check(a['full_20'] and a['full_10'] and not a['exit_observed'])
head=np.full(n,.5);xy=np.full(n,math.hypot(.02,.03))
for horizon in (10,20):
 q=t<=horizon+1e-9
 for key,v in [('head',head),('xy',xy)]:
  expected=sum((v[:-1][q[1:]]+v[1:][q[1:]])*.5*np.diff(t)[q[1:]])
  check(np.isclose(a[f'{key}_int_{horizon}'],expected,atol=1e-12))
  check(np.isclose(a[f'{key}_p95_{horizon}'],v[0],atol=1e-12))
 expected=sum(x[0]**2/np.diag(P[0]))
 check(np.isclose(a[f'nees4_{horizon}'],expected))
 check(a[f'heading_coverage95_{horizon}']==1.)
y=x.copy();y[5:15,2]=np.radians(2.)
a=e.measure(t,y,P,truth,0.,True)
check(abs(a['exit_s']-1.)<1e-12 and abs(a['reentry_s']-5.)<1e-12 and abs(a['reentry_duration_s']-4.)<1e-12)
y=x.copy();y[:10,2]=np.radians(2.)
a=e.measure(t,y,P,truth,0.,False)
check(abs(a['recovery_s']-4.)<1e-12 and a['exit_observed'] is None and math.isnan(a['exit_s']))
a=e.measure(t[:-1],x[:-1],P[:-1],truth[:-1],0.,True)
check(not a['full_20'] and a['full_10'] and math.isnan(a['head_int_20']))
z=t.copy();z[-1]-=5e-10
a=e.measure(z,x,P,truth,0.,True);check(a['full_20'])
# Verify seed weighting, abstention/applied denominator, censoring and deterministic PCG64 bootstrap without disk writes.
class Sink:
 def __init__(self):self.data={}
 def __truediv__(self,k):
  q=io.StringIO();self.data[k]=q;return q
rows=[]
for seed,vals in [(10,[1.,3.]),(11,[100.])]:
 for v in vals:
  rows.append(dict(stage='S3',route='R5',bias='B0',channel='Full',arm='D_CP',accurate=True,seed=seed,pose_id=len(rows),effect='harm',applied=True,delta_head_int_20=v,on_full_20=True,off_full_20=True,on_exit_s=1.,off_exit_s=np.nan,on_reentry_s=4.,off_reentry_s=np.nan,on_recovery_s=np.nan,off_recovery_s=np.nan,delta_exit_s=np.nan))
rows.append(dict(rows[0],pose_id=3,effect='tie',applied=False,delta_head_int_20=0.))
rows.append(dict(rows[0],pose_id=4,effect='censored',applied=False,delta_head_int_20=np.nan,on_full_20=False,off_full_20=False))
for row in rows:
 for target in ('recovered','exited','reentered'):
  for pre in ('on_only','off_only','both','neither'):row[f'{pre}_{target}']=False
frame=pd.DataFrame(rows);sink=Sink();s.aggregate(frame,sink);rt.tabulate(frame,sink)
tables={k:pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(v.getvalue())) for k,v in sink.data.items()}
ap=tables['PAIRED_SUMMARY.csv'].query("population=='applied' and metric=='delta_head_int_20'").iloc[0]
rng=np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(20261103));v=np.array([2.,100.]);CI=np.percentile(np.median(v[rng.integers(2,size=(10000,2))],axis=1),[2.5,97.5])
check(ap['median']==51. and np.array_equal([ap.lo,ap.hi],CI) and ap.seeds==2)
den=tables['DENOMINATORS.csv'];check(den.query("population=='attempt'").iloc[0].events==5 and den.query("population=='applied'").iloc[0].events==3)
rates=tables['EVENT_RATES.csv'];attempt=rates.query("population=='attempt'").iloc[0];check(attempt.registered==5 and attempt.events==5 and attempt.complete20==4 and attempt.censored20==1 and attempt.on_exit_rate==1. and attempt.off_exit_rate==0.)
single=Sink();s.aggregate(frame[frame.seed==11],single);tab=pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(single.data['PAIRED_SUMMARY.csv'].getvalue()));check(tab.lo.isna().all() and tab.hi.isna().all())
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','endpoint_summary_rates_assertions':tests,'files_written':0,'seed_summary_artifact_present':any('SEED' in k for k in tables),'table_names':list(tables)}))

r=pathlib.Path('/mnt/d/codex/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103');pkg=r/'research/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103'
for rel in ['S2/runs/DEV_REPAIR_001/TRACE_INDEX.json','S3/runs/DEV_001/TRACE_INDEX.json']:
 idx=json.loads((pkg/rel).read_bytes());print(rel,len(idx),dict(collections.Counter(x['kind'] for x in idx)))
cache=pathlib.Path('/mnt/d/codex/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103_inputs/S1_INPUTS/algorithm_input')

counts=collections.Counter();checked=set();max_time=0.
for l in labels:
 stage=l['stage'];route=l['route'];bias=l['bias'];ch=l['channel'];seed=int(l['seed']);arm=l['arm']
 k=int(l['index']);key=f'{route}_aB_m0_{bias}_{ch}';fname=f'{key}_{seed}_{arm}'+('_main' if stage=='S3' else '')+'.npz'
 source=pkg/stage/'runs/EVAL_001';idx={x['file']:x for x in json.loads((source/'TRACE_INDEX.json').read_bytes())};rec=idx[fname];path=source/fname
 if str(path) not in checked:
  assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==rec['sha256']
  checked.add(str(path))
 with np.load(path) as z,np.load(cache/(key+'.npz')) as pk:
  assert np.array_equal(z['pose_id'],pk['pose_id'])
  assert np.array_equal(z['t'],pk['t'])

  if 'time' in ev[0]:assert abs(float(ev[0]['time'])-float(pk['t'][k]))<1e-9
 counts[(stage,route,ch,l['accurate'],l['applied'])]+=1
print(json.dumps({'registry_events':len(labels),'source_files':len(checked),'checks':'all 520 registry times, pose IDs; each natural source full timestamp/source vector and SHA256','counts':{'|'.join(k):v for k,v in counts.items()}}))
